normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 visible terminal-cell rows after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming. Each row also pins exact raw pre/post SHA-256 and one-based inclusive blank-column ranges.
policy: Candidate-only reconciliation of terminal Batch 30 decisions. Independent crosschecks are authoritative. Identical accepted coordinates are deduplicated; compatible ranges are merged only after individual and merged replay against the live row. Missing reports, hash drift, unresolved decisions, action/hash conflicts, canonical-history overlap, source locks, stale rows, geometry/control drift, and un-crosschecked proposals fail closed.
